defaultsNote: Reference starting positions, not a capture. Master is excluded. A capture that doesn't state EQ on/off is taken as EQ on.

definitionSource: capture settings / JCM800 Lead model layout
defaultsNote: Starting settings: Brit 1987 1. Two blendable input channels (I: High Treble; II: Normal), not footswitchable channels. Patch routes shown are those recorded in this dataset.
Starting settings: CA 3Axe 1 (RHY Green); Lead drive starting values are mid-range of the recorded ones. The eight modes are the RHY/LD1/LD2 LED matrix, not footswitchable amp channels.

fullName: TriAxis preamp into Stereo Simul-Class 2:Ninety power amp · rack
defaultsNote: Starting settings: CA 3Axe+290 1 (RHY Yellow). Captures record one power-amp Level/Presence without saying side A or B; they are shown in the A position.
Starting settings: Aggi Hammer 500 1. Master, the −10 dB pad and the rear/side jacks are not recorded in any capture and are not shown.
Starting settings: Iba Green 9 1. The status LED, footswitch, jacks and the lower body of the pedal are not recorded and are not shown.
Starting settings: OC-76 Comp 1. DRY is on the pedal but not in any capture, so it is shown and not matched. The jacks, gain-reduction meter, LED and footswitch are not recorded and are not shown.

fullName: Darkglass Ultra plugin · Microtubes B7K Ultra pedal
defaultsNote: Starting settings: Darkglass Ultimate 8 (the captures are named “Darkglass Ultimate”, but describe the Darkglass Ultra plugin). The mid-switch frequencies follow the order printed on the pedal. Bypass, LEDs and jacks are not recorded and are not shown.

fullName: Darkglass Ultimate plugin · Microtubes B7K Ultra pedal section
defaultsNote: Starting settings: Darkglass Ultimate 3. Only the plugin's B7K/VU pedal section is compared; its compressor, fuzz, cab and EQ settings stay in the description. The mid-switch frequencies follow the order printed on the pedal.

Starting settings: Bogna X100B Ch2 1 (channel 1 and 3 controls from Ch1 1 and Ch3 1). Channel 1 has its own Treble/Middle/Bass; channels 2 and 3 share theirs, plus the Air and Gain Lo/Hi switches. Sound Style and Variac are rear-panel switches, shown at the left. Pre EQ “Normal”/“Middle” in descriptions means Mid.

Starting settings: Bogna X100B Pre Ch2 Hi 1 (channel 1 and 3 controls from Pre Ch1 1 and Pre Ch3 Lead 1). Only the preamp's per-channel controls are captured; Presence, Master, Excursion and the rear switches belong to the power amp section. The descriptions write Gain Mode as a second “Gain” line (Lead/Plexi).
Starting settings: Bogna X100B PA NEW 1. The power amp section's controls only: Presence, Master Volume and Excursion on the front, Sound Style (written “Style”) and Variac on the rear panel.

fullName: Mark IIC+ · head with 5-band graphic EQ
defaultsNote: Starting settings: CA MkCC+ 1. The PULL labels above the knobs are the pull switches. Lead Drive, Lead Master and its Pull Bright only count while Pull Lead is on (dimmed otherwise). Presence and the Simul-Class / Class A switch sit on the rear panel; they are shown where the standby and power switches are. The EQ in/auto switch isn't recorded by any capture, so it is left out (every capture states the slider positions).

Starting settings: US HRDLX ChA 1 (Drive, More Drive and Master from US HRDLX ChB 1). Captures call the channels A (Normal) and B (Drive); CHANNEL SELECT on the panel switches between them, and the controls the other channel doesn't use are dimmed. The knobs are printed 1–12; a few captures write 0, shown fully counter-clockwise like 1. Reverb is on the panel but no capture records it: shown, not matched.

model: Hot Rod Deluxe Power amp section
fullName: Hot Rod Deluxe · power amp section (6V6)
defaultsNote: Starting settings: US HRDLX PA 6V6 5. The power amp section's only recorded control is Presence; the knobs are printed 1–12 and a capture at 0 is shown fully counter-clockwise like 1.

fullName: Mark III (red stripe) · head with 5-band graphic EQ
defaultsNote: Starting settings: CA MkIIIRed 1 (Lead Drive and Lead Master from CA MkIIIRed 4). Same faceplate as the Mark IIC+, with PULL RHYTHM 2 on Middle (captures write it “Pull Rhythm” or “Pull Rhythm2”). Captures that don’t use the lead circuit write the lead controls as N/A; they only count while Pull Lead is on (dimmed otherwise). Presence sits on the rear panel; it’s shown where the standby and power switches are.

definitionSource: front panel photos + capture settings (rear-panel Presence and Master per the published panel layout)
defaultsNote: Starting settings: Bogna Fish 1 (Country), 3 (Brown), 5 (Strato), 7 (Shark). The channel labels on the panel (STRATO ▶, BROWN ▶, SHARK ▶, ◀ COUNTRY) pick the channel; captures call Country “Clean”. Brown and Strato share the top-row tone stack. The controls the selected channel doesn’t use are dimmed. Presence and Master sit on the rear panel; they are shown where the power switch is.

fullName: Fish preamp into a Stereo Simul-Class 2:Ninety power amp · rack
defaultsNote: Starting settings: Bogna Fish+290 1 (Country), 7 (Brown), 5 (Strato), 3 (Shark). The Fish above the Simul-Class 2:Ninety it was captured through; captures write each channel’s level and gain knobs as plain “Volume” and “Gain”. Captures call Country “Clean”, and one sets its switch to the middle position (between Jazz and Funk).
